/--
$1$ is $r$-full for any $r$.
-/
lemma erdos_1107_full_1 (r : ℕ) : Nat.Full r 1 := by
  intro p hp
  have h : p ^ r ∣ 1 := by
    rw [Nat.pow]
    induction r <;> simp_all [Nat.dvd_one]
  exact h

/--
Every $n$ is a sum of at most $r+1$ ones, hence $r$-full, for $r \ge 2$.
-/
lemma erdos_1107_sum_of_ones (r n : ℕ) (h2 : r ≥ 2) : SumOfRPowerful r n := by
  have h_pos : 0 < r + 1 := by omega
  refine ⟨List.rep n 1, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h : (List.rep n 1).length = n := by
      simp [List.length_rep]
    rw [h]
    have h_le : n ≤ r + 1 := by
      have := Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.add_one_lt_add_one (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt h2 (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.le_refl r))))
      omega
    exact h_le
  · simp [List.mem_rep]
    intro x hx
    simp_all
    exact erdos_1107_full_1 r
  · have h : (List.rep n 1).sum = n := by
      simp [List.sum_rep, Nat.mul_one]
    rw [h]
